previewReady.title: Your preview is ready
previewReady.body: Open Kök to see it. It is an AI preview, not a prediction of your result.

giftExpiring.title: Your gift is still waiting
giftExpiring.body: Your annual plan discount ends on {{date}}.

care.title: Day {{day}} of your care plan
care.body: Open today's steps. Your clinic's instructions always come first.

shed.title: Week {{week}} — shedding is typical around now
shed.body: Many people see shedding in this phase. Open your guide to see what is typical. Individual results vary.

quiet.title: The quiet phase is typical around now
quiet.body: Many people feel nothing is happening in these weeks. Open your guide to see what is typical.

sprout.title: First growth is typical around now
sprout.body: Fine new hairs often start to appear in this phase. Timing varies from person to person.

grow.title: The growth phase
grow.body: Density usually builds gradually. Keep taking same-angle photos to see the change. Individual results vary.

mature.title: The maturing phase
mature.body: Results keep settling over the coming months. Individual results vary.

final.title: Time for a full review
final.body: Around the one-year mark many people compare their whole photo series. Open your guide.

photo.title: Time for a progress photo
photo.body: Same angle, same light, a few seconds. Your series is what makes change visible.

shed.title: Quick shed check
shed.body: Log how much you noticed today. Shedding is typical in this phase.

session.title: PRP session tomorrow
session.body: Your session is on {{date}}. Take a same-angle photo beforehand so you can compare later.
